strings.TMY_all_alone_desc: Surrounded on all sides by those who hated Taboritsky, and far from the old heartlands, the self-proclaimed Blessed Regent Dikiy waves between sobbing fits of despair and delusions of grandeur. As the last bastion of Russian Nazism in the east, it is at least somewhat comforting for his subjects to know how tenuous and miserable an existence he leads.
